name: BSP_LuaObjectives_Add
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(LuaState*) -> int, RET at 008cdd59; literal 'luaMW_Objectives_Add failed:'. Builds a slot bitmask by comparing Lua integers against [game+18CCh + 4*i]+28h, then for each set bit calls the objective set at game+21A4h + 4*slot (loop bound 0x21c4). The mapping from Lua argument positions to the 008dd5c0 constructor arguments is not settled. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md. | Packet cc8_mission_objectives, read-only analysis. SETTLES docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md's open uncertainty about the Lua argument order. 00B677E0 BSP_LuaObject_ArgumentAt is __thiscall(frame, out, index) and the index is the FIRST of its three pushes (008CD5D6 PUSH 1 / LEA EAX,[ESP+24h] / PUSH EAX / LEA ECX,[ESP+5Ch] / CALL); recovering that push at every call site gives: arg0 optional int (008CD544 IsInteger, 008CD57F/008CD59A GetInteger) the party; arg1 optional int (008CD5E1, 008CD617/008CD626) the player slot; arg2 string (008CD65A/008CD669) the OBJECTIVE NAME; arg3 string (008CD6D3/008CD6E2) and arg4 string (008CD744/008CD758) text; arg5 optional bool (008CD7D6 IsBoolean, 008CD832/008CD846 GetBoolean); arg6 onward the targets, walked without an immediate index through 008CD8DB IsVector3Table and the 008CD9BA/008CDA48 IterateFirst/IterateNext flatten. The add loop at 008CDAF0 SHL EAX,CL tests the slot mask at [ESP+1Ch] and 008CDB09 MOV ECX,[EDX+EBP] takes the set at game+21A4h+slot*4 before 008CDB20 CALL 008E1F80; the tail adds targets through 008CDBD6 008DF9B0 and 008CDC56 008DF5D0. Run-time: every call in IJN01, USN01 and USN02 has argc=6, so no target block, and 008CDD60 Objectives_AddUnit is never called on any of them.

name: BSP_LuaObjectives_AddUnit
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(lua_State*) Lua binding Objectives_AddUnit(party, playerSlot, objectiveName, target, ...). Argument 0 builds a slot mask by comparing each of the eight players at game+18CCh+k*4, field +28h, with the integer (008cde8f..008cdef2); argument 1, when player+8h is set and player+9h clear, replaces the mask with 1 shl slot (008cdfdb..008cdff1); argument 2 is the objective name; arguments 3 upward are entity tables or Vector3 tables, table arguments flattened by iteration. For each set bit the binding calls 008df9b0 at 008ce3ae or 008df5d0 at 008ce42d on the objective set at game+21A4h+slot*4 (008ce2ec..008ce455). docs/OBJECTIVE_UNIT_LIST.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_GetPayload
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction for the GetPayload row of the mission binding table 00E0B7B8 (row at 00E0C578, name pointer 00D0EFB4), exported by tools/lua_bindings_export.py into config/lua_bindings.json. Established as entity-returning mechanically: the body pushes the literal 00CE7494 ("thisTable") into 00B67910 BSP_LuaObject_GetByLiteral and reaches 00B663D0 BSP_LuaObject_PushValue, which is the nine-call tail read in full at 00898E30 BSP_LuaBinding_FindEntity (00898F98-00899045): decimal key from the u16 at entity+174h, thisTable[key], lua_pushvalue, return lua_gettop - frame base. The body itself was not read by this packet, so only the return convention is attributed, not the lookup. docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_EnableMessages
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction __fastcall(lua_State* in ECX), RET 0, returns 0. Row 00E0C788, global EnableMessages, 170 scripts. Three argument shapes decided by the count alone: two or more takes the entity from slot 0 (008CFF4E) and the flag from slot 1 (008CFF71), one takes the flag from slot 0 (008CFF95), none leaves the flag at the default true (008CFF6A MOV BL,1). The byte stored is the negation (SETZ at 008CFFEB and 008CFFFE): per entity through the map find-or-insert 0077EDF0 on *(00F8A0C4)+D4h (008CFFE4), or globally at *(00F8A0C4)+D0h (008D0000) followed by 0096BF70 when messages are being turned off (008D000A). Pushes nothing. docs/LUA_BINDING_CORE.md.
